Domain Live

Near-real-time domain discovery & analytics platform

System Architecture Overview

A near-real-time domain analytics platform built with Spring Boot, Flask, and Next.js. It processes discovered domains, validates registration metadata through RDAP, segments domain names into keywords, and serves precomputed analytics through a live dashboard.

ENGINEERING FOCUSDecoupled ingestion and keyword processing through a PENDING → PARSED pipeline, with batched background workers and precomputed analytics using JPQL aggregates and composite indexes.
RELIABILITY CONTRACTBounded ingestion queues, controlled RDAP concurrency, PostgreSQL JSONB snapshots, and Redis caching. Uses best-effort certificate discovery rather than a complete domain-registration feed.

Production Engineering Log
01Debugged and resolved a silent real-time alert failure in a microservices architecture by tracing a cross-service state refresh that broadcasted to all user-owned devices instead of the triggering device.
02Developed a Spring Boot service to parse over 100K daily GPS records, extracting trip and stop events while effectively handling dropped packets, invalid coordinates, and offline device scenarios.
03Designed a fault-tolerant background recovery service that detects and recomputes missing daily data summaries on demand, ensuring 100% data completeness when scheduled cron jobs fail across services.
04Migrated a mobile Flutter app to a web application within an Agile sprint cycle, integrating over 6 web-compatible APIs (Google Maps JS, Firebase Web, WebSocket) to replace incompatible plugins, successfully shipping to production.
05Redesigned device troubleshooting logic by mapping unhandled failure states, resulting in a ~70% reduction in escalation rate.
06Reduced over 2 redundant API calls per session by replacing timer-based polling with state-driven triggers.
